item.title: Kollakkayil Devaki Amma: The Padma Shri Awardee Who Built A Forest
item.description: Kollakkayil Devaki Amma G received the Padma Shri award for her lifelong contribution to afforestation and environmental conservation in Kerala. Based in the Alappuzha district, she transformed barren coastal sandy land into a thriving green ecosystem through consistent personal effort.
